how to provide water samples for laboratory isotopic analysis
==========
1. Take required sampling materials from laboratory (See Fig. 1):
     - sampling flash
     - label
     - parafilm
     - syringe
     - box
2. fill completely the sampling flash with intended water using syringe.
3. close the flash cap slighlty.
4. cover the flash cap with parafilm (See Fig. 2).
5. label the flash
6. place the filled flashes inside the box
7. write the required information on the box (See Fig.3)
